_help: Only GUMROAD_PRODUCT_LINK, LEGAL NAME and ADDRESS are left for the owner. LEGAL NAME and ADDRESS appear ONLY on the terms and privacy pages. launch_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is set by Claude on deploy day; the launch end date and page dates are worked out from it. site_url and BRAND_EMAIL are pre-filled with the planned values: change them if the real ones differ. Never put passwords here.
